LESSON: POSITION AND DIRECTION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: GEOMETRY
Topic 3.1: Position and Direction
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Position and Direction, part of GEOMETRY in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do you cross the road when you get to a road junction?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign ‘position’, ‘direction’ and related terms.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. move along a straight line from a point,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. identify right and left side from a point.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. turn to the right from a point,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. turn to the left from a point.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. appreciate directions and make right turns in real life situations. ● In pairs or groups, learners are guided to identify, fingerspell and sign ‘position’, ‘direction’, ‘right’, ‘left’, ‘turn’. ● In pair or groups, learners are guided to are guided to watch signed videos with captions, demonstrations, or illustrations on movement, along a straight line, turning left and right. ● In pairs or groups, learners are guided to practice moving along a straight line from a given point outside the classroom. ● In pairs or groups, learners are guided to play a game of identifying right and left from a point. ● In pair or groups, learners are guided to are guided to move straight along the outside of their classroom and then turn to the right. How do you cross the road when you get to a road junction? 33 ● In pairs or groups, learners are guided to move straight along the outside of their classroom and then turn to the left. ● In pairs or are guided to practice moving along a straight line and turning left or right. ● In pairs or groups, learners are guided to watch and play digital games on movement.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Position and Direction in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Position and Direction together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners know their school as they identify in pairs or in groups, places to move straight along the outside of their

classroom and then turn to the left.

● Learning to Learn: Learning independently is enhanced as learners recreate moving along a straight line from a given point outside the

classroom and turning left or right.

Values:
Respect: In pairs or in groups, display patience as they practise moving in turns along a straight line and turning left or right.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness: Learners use their body parts in movement in moving along a straight line from a given point outside

classroom.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of position and direction to the concept of location in Environmental Activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

● Charts showing a straight line, a turn to the left and a turn to the right.
